Kyber Network is a decentralized liquidity protocol that runs on the Ethereum blockchain. Kyber Network executes token swaps through smart contracts without a centralized intermediary. Kyber Network sources liquidity from reserves that are contributed by liquidity providers. Kyber Network uses the KNC token in its governance and incentive mechanisms.

Gyroscope is a stablecoin protocol that issues the GYD stablecoin through smart contracts. Gyroscope backs GYD with a reserve of multiple assets rather than a single asset.

Quickswap is a decentralized exchange that operates on the Polygon blockchain. Quickswap uses an automated market maker design based on the Uniswap V2 model. Quickswap lets users swap tokens and provide liquidity through smart contracts without an intermediary.

Aerodrome is a decentralized exchange that operates on the Base blockchain. Aerodrome uses a vote-escrowed tokenomics model derived from the Solidly design. Aerodrome uses the AERO token for governance and incentives.
